data.title: Strategy stock falls as Michael Saylor's bitcoin giant faces index-level threat
data.description: Strategy stock fell more than 3% on Friday after index provider MSCI announced new eligibility rules that could lead to the removal of Michael Saylor's bitcoin juggernaut from its global stock indexes.
